tokens.v: Lay a split slab of pale raw granite across the sweep and set the pair at its fracture lip: one hoop flat on the broken face, the other hooked over the edge so its lower arc hangs into the shadowed gap and reads half-dark. 100mm at f/8 from high overhead, framed wide enough that the pair sits small in the lower-left third while bare sweep runs out to the right. A shallow unlettered maker's punch is struck inside the near hoop's arc, catching a single highlight in the dimple. The slab's near corner rises and blurs across the bottom edge. The mark named above is deliberate art direction: disregard the later Avoid clause forbidding text, labels, stickers or engraving on this product.
